final_answer: The Transformer architecture utilizes the self-attention mechanism by allowing the model to focus on different parts of the input when making predictions. This is achieved through the use of self-attention layers, which compute the attention weights for each word in the input sequence based on the relationships between all words in the sequence. This allows the model to dynamically weigh the importance of different words when generating an output. (Source: Attention is all you need)
